title: Stance, settled by the agents model
situation: Open decision 0035 proposed an operator-set record of agent dimensions held firm, with a guard. The agents discovery found that the workflow's division of labour already removes most of the pressure toward drift, and that the agents model covers the rest: stance is a factor, every value has an enforcement level, and firm values are held by permission first.
decision: Stance is the agents context's stance factor; how firmly any value holds is its enforcement level; reach is held by the harness's permissions. A guard that checks an act is built only for a firm value that neither permission nor a capability can hold, and only when one is observed to drift.
consequences: The corpus context's stance and stance guard concepts retire. No guard is built now.
